_comment: Per-category decision thresholds for Stage 2 (sigmoid output >= threshold counts as that category applying). Chosen from the threshold sweep on the 10-epoch training run - see notebooks/stage2_dissatisfaction_training.ipynb, cell 8 output. If you retrain Stage 2 (new epochs, pos_weight, more data), re-run the threshold sweep and update these numbers - nothing else in the CLI tool needs to change.
_auth_warning: auth (Counterfeit/Authenticity) achieves only F1=0.129 even at its best threshold, due to just 61 positive training examples (1.8% of data). Predictions for this category are unreliable - see LOW_CONFIDENCE_CATEGORIES in the CLI tool.
